description: This file defines the 'model' package for Prometheus metrics, including validation schemes, escaping mechanisms, and metric data structures.

classes.name: ValidationScheme
classes.description: Enum for metric and label name validation schemes (unset, legacy, utf8).

classes.name: EscapingScheme
classes.description: Enum for different escaping schemes for metric names and labels.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: Type representing a single metric with labels, similar to LabelSet.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of ValidationScheme or EscapingScheme.

methods.name: MarshalYAML
methods.description: Serializes ValidationScheme to YAML.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Deserializes ValidationScheme from YAML.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes ValidationScheme to JSON.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes ValidationScheme from JSON.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets ValidationScheme based on string input.

methods.name: IsValidMetricName
methods.description: Checks if a metric name is valid according to the current validation scheme.

methods.name: IsValidLabelName
methods.description: Checks if a label name is valid according to the current validation scheme.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of EscapingScheme.

methods.name: ToEscapingScheme
methods.description: Converts string to EscapingScheme.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Compares two Metrics for equality.

methods.name: Before
methods.description: Compares underlying label sets of two Metrics.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Metric.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Metric.

methods.name: Fingerprint
methods.description: Returns the fingerprint of the Metric.

methods.name: FastFingerprint
methods.description: Returns a faster, less collision-resistant fingerprint of the Metric.

methods.name: EscapeMetricFamily
methods.description: Escapes metric names and labels in a MetricFamily according to a scheme.

methods.name: metricNeedsEscaping
methods.description: Checks if a Metric requires escaping.

methods.name: EscapeName
methods.description: Escapes a name string according to a scheme.

methods.name: UnescapeName
methods.description: Unescapes a name string according to a scheme.

methods.name: isValidLegacyRune
methods.description: Checks if a rune is valid in legacy validation.
